Chapter 767: Chapter 40: Setting Sail Again (End Of This Volume, Thanks To The Alliance Hierarch Reward From '知人_论世')

Chapter 767: Chapter 40: Setting Sail Again (End of this volume, thanks to the Alliance Hierarch reward from ‘知人_论世’)

“What a monstrous talent…”

The half-meter-tall old man marveled to himself, for he had discerned that Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the spatia-temporal fusion rule was not profound when he was in the two-dimensional world.

There was an unimaginably long distance to go before he could enlighten the spatio-temporal fusion rule.

This time, by offering Lin Yuan the insight into the spatia-temporal fusion rule he had cut off, he merely speculated that Lin Yuan would take a big step toward that enlightenment, at most.

But who could have imagined that Lin Yuan would directly enlighten the spatio-temporal fusion rule?

“As long as he can overcome the challenge of the twelfth-rank life, perhaps he may one day grow close to the heights of a Perfect Time Being?”

The half-meter-tall old man silently pondered.

Being close to a Perfect Time Being was the highest praise he could think of, as for a real Perfect Time Being? They could easily traverse numerous timelines, able to reverse the past and alter the future at will.

A Perfect Time Being is an existence that transcends dimensions and cannot be described in terms of normal life.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

After Lin Yuan enlightened the spatio-temporal fusion rule, his consciousness immediately descended into his inner world.

Boom boom boom.

As time and space completely merged, his inner world began to transform, and while its superficial size remained the same, the number of spatial layers instantly reached a hundred billion.

And seemingly intangible, every aspect of his inner world saw significant improvement.

“My inner world now… If I were to undergo the Chaos Void Origin infusion once more, it would withstand an origin infusion over ten thousand times more than when breaking through from the ninth to the tenth rank.”

Lin Yuan had an idea, his enlightenment of the spatio-temporal fusion rule had brought him an enormous boost, even within the ranks of eleventh-rank lives, this was a metamorphosis, entering the fourth layer of the eleventh tier.

“That crystal light group…” Lin Yuan’s spirit was exhilarated.

Encased within the crystal light group were the comprehensions regarding the spatio-temporal fusion rule from all the myriad tribes’ powerhouses that had fallen into the two-dimensional world.

This naturally included the insights from legendary lives like the Four Divine Kings and the skinny old man, who were at the level eleven perfection, regarding the spatio-temporal fusion rule.

And these legendary lives had all reached the Fifth Realm in the spatio-temporal fusion rule.

In other words, the minimum threshold for that crystal light group is to elevate Lin Yuan’s understanding of the spatio-temporal fusion rule to the Fifth Realm.

And the limit?

With over a hundred million myriad tribes’ powerhouses’ different ‘facets’ of understanding the spatio-temporal fusion rule, a quantitative change could induce a qualitative change, possibly enabling Lin Yuan to step into the Sixth Realm in the spatio-temporal fusion rule domain in one fell swoop.

It’s known that fusion rules range from the First Realm to the Ninth Realm.

A Seventh Realm in an ordinary fusion rule is the maximum level obtainable by an eleventh-rank life.

And the Seventh Realm in pillar-level fusion rules is the domain of ultimate beings.

As for the Seventh Realm in a top-level fusion rule like the spatio-temporal fusion rule… let alone the Seventh Realm, even the Sixth Realm is something only ultimate beings can enlighten.

If Lin Yuan were to practice the spatio-temporal fusion rule to the Sixth Realm, it would mean that he could, in some aspects, stand shoulder to shoulder with an ultimate being.

“The Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm is still too far away,” Lin Yuan steadied his spirit, such a leap into the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm was in theory only.

A quantitative change inducing a qualitative change is true, but if understanding from merely a hundred million myriad tribes’ powerhouses could achieve the Sixth Realm, then the domain of ultimate beings would seem rather cheap.

And among these hundred million myriad tribes’ powerhouses, the vast majority were eighth and ninth rank, with a rather one-sided understanding of the spatio-temporal fusion rule.

…

Within the White Paper.

After enlightening the spatio-temporal fusion rule, Lin Yuan collected his thoughts and bowed slightly towards the half-meter-tall old man, “Thank you, Elder.”

Although it’s true that Lin Yuan’s insights into the spatio-temporal fusion rule came entirely from the rules of the low-dimensional space,

it’s always right to be polite.

“No need to thank me,”

“All this is what you deserve,”

The half-meter-tall old man looked deeply at Lin Yuan, the same spatio-temporal fusion rule insights that could take other strong beings centuries to absorb just a portion and thereby enlighten the spatio-temporal fusion rule,

Yet Lin Yuan only spent less than half an hour.

The gap is something anyone could see.

“Now that the game is over, as for those participants who died, the essence and mysteries of their physical bodies, their understanding of other rules, their soul core and so on, keeping them myself would be of no use, would you want them?” the half-meter-tall old man asked after a moment of silence.

“Ah?”

“These I can have?”

Lin Yuan looked at the half-meter-tall old man in bewilderment.

Weren’t we supposed to choose only one? Why can we choose everything now?

“According to the rules, you can only choose one, but I have the authority to handle the rest, and keeping them here would be a waste,” the half-meter-tall old man explained.

“Then, I want them,” Lin Yuan immediately said.

What a joke.

Given the exaggerated effect of watching the crystal light group just now, if Lin Yuan were to hesitate, he’d truly be a fool.

It’s like an enormous stroke of fortune falling from the sky.

“Then they’re yours,” the half-meter-tall old man said without hesitation, waving his right hand, and four more crystal light groups appeared, flying towards Lin Yuan.

Compared with the crystal light group that represented the understanding of the spatio-temporal fusion rule, these four light groups were much ‘murkier’ and nowhere near as pure as the former.

“These four parts, I did not especially purify, you might encounter some disturbances during your comprehension,” the half-meter-tall old man cautioned.

“Understood,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Even if they were ‘murkier’, comprehending them would be far simpler than directly understanding the fusion rules, equivalent to a shortcut to the heavens.

“If possible, try to comprehend the Chaos Rules before you challenge the Twelfth Rank,” the half-meter-tall elder pondered for a while before he spoke.

“Chaos Rules?”

Lin Yuan put away the five sparkling orbs and looked toward the half-meter-tall elder seated before the huge scroll.

This was not the first time Lin Yuan had heard of the Chaos Rules; Shen Ji from the Demon Jade Space, the Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and Xia Qin, the Supreme Being, had all mentioned the Chaos Rules.

“Correct.”

“Of course, don’t pursue the Chaos Rules too eagerly. After all… after all, for lives below the Twelfth Rank, they are but a legend,” said the half-meter-tall elder.

Seeing Lin Yuan’s displayed perceptiveness, combined with the understanding of rules from over a hundred million powerhouses, gave the half-meter-tall elder an inexplicable confidence.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

To comprehend the Chaos Rules would be greatly beneficial for challenging the ultimate; if possible, Lin Yuan would naturally do his best to understand them.

“This game is over; it’s time for me to leave,” the half-meter-tall elder sighed.

He controlled ‘White Paper’ and stayed within this universe, which seemed to the outside world as if he were being prevented from leaving by the actions of many Supreme Beings.

But in reality, it was after absorbing enough lives into the scroll, followed by the start of the game, that he stopped, which was more a matter of going with the flow.

“Leave?”

Lin Yuan looked at the half-meter-tall elder.

“Yes.”

“How do you plan to leave?”

“Will you head out directly, or should I send you to a hidden location?” the half-meter-tall elder asked.

Aware of many Twelfth-Rank lives peeking outside the scroll, he had naturally taken notice well in advance.

Therefore, he made a point of asking Lin Yuan.

“Send me to a hidden location,” Lin Yuan said without hesitation.

Going out directly would be like exposing himself to numerous ultimate entities.

If it were before, when the many powerhouses of the Myriad Tribes in the two-dimensional world were not yet dead, there probably wouldn’t be any serious trouble, as long as the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization swiftly concealed Lin Yuan’s aura to prevent it from leaking the life aura of the Tenth Rank.

But now?

In the two-dimensional world, apart from Lin Yuan, the other powerhouses of the Myriad Tribes had died out, becoming ‘nourishment’ for Lin Yuan’s growth. The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule was comprehended directly, not without the support of the Four Divine Kings and many other special lives.

Going out at this time is not to say that the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization could not protect him, but it would definitely trigger a grand battle at the level of the Twelfth Stage Powerhouses.

“No problem,” said the half-meter-tall elder with a nod.

He had a way to elude the perception of the Twelfth Rank powerhouses. Previously, when he sent out the native lives that had entered the celestial gate in the two-dimensional world, it was also done quietly, without any ultimate entities knowing.

…

Outside the scroll.

The numerous Supreme Beings covertly surrounded the mysterious scroll. Ever since their own people died in the two-dimensional world and after Xia Qin, the Supreme Being, guided the reasoning towards ‘White Paper’ being a ‘living creature’,

the many Supreme Beings were considering using force against ‘White Paper’.

At that moment.

Buzz, buzz, buzz.

Under the astonished gazes of all the Supreme Beings, the slowly unfolding mysterious ‘scroll’ began to sway slightly.

Every sway stirred up millions, tens of millions, hundreds of millions of light-years of spacetime fluctuations.

“Not good.”

“The ‘White Paper’ wants to leave,” the numerous Supreme Beings changed their expressions, immediately sensing ‘White Paper’s’ intent.

But it was to no avail.

Even with the combined efforts of all the Supreme Beings to suppress it, they still couldn’t stop ‘White Paper’.

Boom!

Immense powers of space-time churned, and ‘White Paper’, breaking free from the Supreme Beings’ suppression, began to fly through the Cosmic Starry Skies at a terrifying speed.

Soon.

A vast crack appeared, and ‘White Paper’ smoothly rushed into the fissure, leaving this universe.

The next moment.

The numerous Supreme Beings arrived in time to see the now vanished ‘White Paper’, their expressions turning ugly.

Supreme Beings receive too many gifts from the universe. Once they enter the Chaos Void, they will face the repulsion of the entire universe, so no Supreme Being dares to pursue.

“We’ve suffered a great loss this time…” the Supreme Being from the Star Alliance thought bitterly. In this event, the unique lives of their Star Alliance faced fundamental losses, and even the ‘hope’ that was the Four Divine Kings with their prospect of reaching the Ultimate, would see reduced chances of challenging the Ultimate because of this event.

Besides, the Star Alliance also lost a Supreme Weapon, the one that the Four Divine Kings had taken into the two-dimensional world.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan looked towards the space rift that ‘White Paper’ had entered from afar.

‘White Paper’ squeezed into the universe and now extricated itself from it in just over a hundred years, but its impact on the Starry Sky Races was profound.

Particularly for Lin Yuan.

Compared to the other Starry Sky Races, the losses of strength for the various Peak Clans,

Lin Yuan’s gain can be described as—

Unprecedented!
